messages.text: That's a concern that many people have, but I think that AI will also create new job opportunities and allow us to focus on more creative and fulfilling work. It's important to consider how we can prepare for the changes that AI will bring to the job market.

messages.speaker: Y
messages.text: Absolutely. It's crucial that we invest in education and training to help people adapt to the changing job market. I think that's all for now, thank you for chatting with me.
